messages.subject: Re: item information function matris
parts:
It is not easy to compute item information functions for MIRT models as unlike unidimensional IRT models they are hyper dimensional in shape.

Phil


On Sat, Sep 16, 2023 at 8:22 PM arif özer <ozer...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi all
I need to item information functions. How to add them to the script at below.
Thank you beforehand
Arif


MBTI4 <- mirt.model('
    EI = 1-24
    SN = 25-43
    TF = 44-66
    JP = 67-91
    COV = JP*EI, JP*TF, JP*SN, EI*TF, EI*SN, TF*SN')
Sonuc4 <- mirt(data=mbti_4, model=MBTI4,
               method= "SEM", itemtype = 'nominal',
               SE=TRUE, verbose=FALSE,
               accelerate = "Ramsay")
summary (Sonuc4)
Sonuc4par <- coef(Sonuc4, IRTpars = TRUE, simplify = TRUE)
MBTI_4NR <- Sonuc4par#$items
print(MBTI_4NR)
